verdict.rationale: A hands-on community user reports that Langfuse publishes an OpenAPI spec usable from any language, so the product does appear to ship a machine-readable spec. However, no first-party doc in the pack documents where to download it, and probes of the common spec paths on langfuse.com all returned 404. Those failed guesses don't contradict the spec's existence, but they leave discoverability unproven. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a downloadable OpenAPI/equivalent spec, a verified download URL, details on spec coverage and versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: the OpenAPI spec is easy to implement in any language
